register: Formal legal and contractual construction used chiefly when a text, clause or agreement expressly lays down a condition.
trap: French normally makes the contract or clause the subject of stipuler; when people reach terms, they conviennent de something rather than stipulent it conversationally.
example_tl: Le contrat stipule que les données collectées en Europe doivent y rester, sauf autorisation expresse de l’autorité de contrôle compétente.
example_en: The contract stipulates that data collected in Europe must remain there unless the competent supervisory authority expressly authorizes otherwise.
cloze: Le contrat {{c1::stipule que}} les données collectées en Europe doivent y rester, sauf autorisation expresse de l’autorité de contrôle compétente.
note: Old_back is accurate; the authored headword adds the productive clause pattern and the example fixes the text-as-subject construction.

register: Formal analytical verb used when claims or accusations are supported with concrete evidence rather than merely repeated.
trap: Substantiel means substantial, not substantiate; étayer commonly takes the claim as its direct object and the evidence after par.
example_tl: Le rapport étaye ses accusations par des courriels internes, des contrats confidentiels et des témoignages concordants recueillis auprès d’anciens salariés.
example_en: The report substantiates its accusations with internal emails, confidential contracts, and consistent testimony gathered from former employees.
cloze: Le rapport {{c1::étaye}} ses accusations par des courriels internes, des contrats confidentiels et des témoignages concordants recueillis auprès d’anciens salariés.
note: Materially corrects old_back, which means to take stock of the situation and does not express evidential support.

register: Neutral analytical construction for advancing a tentative conclusion from incomplete evidence; conjecturer que is more formal and marked.
trap: Surmettre is not a French verb; surmise signals a tentative inference, so conclure que is generally too categorical.
example_tl: Faute de données publiques, les chercheurs supposent que le modèle privilégie les contenus polarisants, mais ils présentent cette conclusion comme provisoire.
example_en: In the absence of public data, the researchers surmise that the model favors polarizing content, but they present this conclusion as provisional.
cloze: Faute de données publiques, les chercheurs {{c1::supposent que}} le modèle privilégie les contenus polarisants, mais ils présentent cette conclusion comme provisoire.
note: Materially corrects the nonexistent old_back and preserves the source verb’s epistemic caution.

register: Neutral verb, often critical in journalism, for promoting something insistently by emphasizing its supposed merits.
trap: The English verb tout is unrelated to French tout; présenter can be neutral and lacks the promotional praise conveyed by vanter.
example_tl: Lors de la conférence, le dirigeant a vanté son assistant automatisé, présenté comme une révolution, sans fournir de chiffres indépendants sur ses performances réelles.
example_en: At the conference, the executive touted his automated assistant, presented as a revolution, without providing independent figures on its actual performance.
cloze: Lors de la conférence, le dirigeant {{c1::a vanté}} son assistant automatisé, présenté comme une révolution, sans fournir de chiffres indépendants sur ses performances réelles.
note: Materially corrects old_back, which copies the English spelling but supplies neither a French verb nor the promotional sense. Self-review removed the calqued vanter comme construction.

register: Written-formal and strongly condemnatory verb for publicly attacking someone as contemptible; commonest in polemical or journalistic prose.
trap: Vilipender takes a direct object and is much stronger than critiquer: it entails abusive disparagement, not reasoned criticism.
example_tl: Pendant la campagne, plusieurs chaînes ont vilipendé les magistrats chargés du dossier, les accusant sans preuve de servir des intérêts étrangers.
example_en: During the campaign, several channels vilified the judges handling the case, accusing them without evidence of serving foreign interests.
cloze: Pendant la campagne, plusieurs chaînes ont {{c1::vilipendé}} les magistrats chargés du dossier, les accusant sans preuve de servir des intérêts étrangers.
note: Old_back is accurate; the example fixes the verb’s force and polemical public register.

register: Neutral-formal analytical verb when facts provide sufficient grounds for an action, conclusion or level of concern.
trap: Garantir translates warrant only in senses such as guaranteeing a product; evidence that warrants an inquiry justifie or motive it.
example_tl: Les irrégularités relevées justifient une enquête indépendante, mais elles ne permettent pas encore de conclure à une fraude organisée.
example_en: The irregularities identified warrant an independent investigation, but they do not yet support the conclusion that organized fraud occurred.
cloze: Les irrégularités relevées {{c1::justifient}} une enquête indépendante, mais elles ne permettent pas encore de conclure à une fraude organisée.
note: Materially corrects old_back by selecting the grounds-for-action sense rather than guarantee.

register: Neutral professional noun for a proposition stated as true; assertion is a more formal alternative in analytical prose.
trap: An assertion is not necessarily false or attributed at a distance; allégation adds the idea of an unproved, often contested claim.
example_tl: L’affirmation selon laquelle le chiffrement empêcherait toute enquête sérieuse ne résiste ni aux données disponibles ni à l’expérience des magistrats.
example_en: The assertion that encryption would prevent any serious investigation withstands neither the available data nor judges’ experience.
cloze: L’{{c1::affirmation}} selon laquelle le chiffrement empêcherait toute enquête sérieuse ne résiste ni aux données disponibles ni à l’expérience des magistrats.
note: Old_back is accurate. Self-review retained affirmation as the less marked production headword and moved the formal cognate to alts.

register: Formal argumentative phrase for a proposition that a speaker or institution actively advances and defends.
trap: Contestation is a false friend here: it means a challenge, dispute or protest, whereas contention in this sense is the claim being defended.
example_tl: La thèse défendue par le ministère est que cette base centralisée accélérera les enquêtes sans créer de nouvel instrument de surveillance.
example_en: The ministry’s contention is that this centralized database will accelerate investigations without creating a new surveillance instrument.
cloze: La {{c1::thèse défendue}} par le ministère est que cette base centralisée accélérera les enquêtes sans créer de nouvel instrument de surveillance.
note: Materially corrects old_back contestation and selects the source’s defended-claim sense.

register: Neutral academic phrasing for a structured evaluation that examines assumptions, methods, strengths and weaknesses.
trap: French une critique can mean a negative comment or a review; analyse critique prevents English critique from being reduced to mere disapproval.
example_tl: L’étude propose une analyse critique des indicateurs de modération, en montrant qu’ils mesurent surtout la rapidité plutôt que la qualité des décisions.
example_en: The study offers a critique of moderation metrics, showing that they primarily measure speed rather than the quality of decisions.
cloze: L’étude propose une {{c1::analyse critique}} des indicateurs de modération, en montrant qu’ils mesurent surtout la rapidité plutôt que la qualité des décisions.
note: The bare source is polysemous. This note selects the structured analytical sense and makes old_back more explicit.

register: Neutral-formal reasoning term for a conclusion presented as following logically from one or more premises.
trap: Déduction is narrower than inférence: deduction claims a logically entailed conclusion, while an inference may be probabilistic or defeasible.
example_tl: La déduction paraît logique, mais elle dépend d’une prémisse non vérifiée : tous les comptes actifs correspondraient à des utilisateurs distincts.
example_en: The deduction appears logical, but it depends on an unverified premise: every active account supposedly corresponds to a distinct user.
cloze: La {{c1::déduction}} paraît logique, mais elle dépend d’une prémisse non vérifiée : tous les comptes actifs correspondraient à des utilisateurs distincts.
note: Old_back is accurate. Retained after self-review specifically to teach the deduction–inference distinction made explicit in the trap.

register: Neutral professional noun for information or explanation that makes an obscure mechanism, statement or issue clearer.
trap: Élucidation is idiomatic for solving a crime or mystery, but it sounds marked where the intended sense is an explanatory éclaircissement.
example_tl: Le rapport apporte un éclaircissement utile sur la manière dont les plateformes calculent les commissions prélevées auprès des petits éditeurs.
example_en: The report provides useful elucidation of how platforms calculate the commissions charged to small publishers.
cloze: Le rapport apporte un {{c1::éclaircissement}} utile sur la manière dont les plateformes calculent les commissions prélevées auprès des petits éditeurs.
note: Replaces the literal old_back with the idiomatic noun for explanatory clarification in the selected professional context.

register: Neutral professional construction for the prominence or priority given to a particular issue, criterion or policy objective.
trap: Emphase usually suggests grandiloquence or excessive force in French; putting emphasis on something is mettre l’accent sur it.
example_tl: L’accent mis sur la vitesse de retrait masque une question essentielle : les recours des utilisateurs sont-ils réellement examinés par des humains ?
example_en: The emphasis on removal speed obscures an essential question: are users’ appeals actually reviewed by humans?
cloze: L’{{c1::accent mis sur}} la vitesse de retrait masque une question essentielle : les recours des utilisateurs sont-ils réellement examinés par des humains ?
note: Materially sharpens old_back: mise en évidence often means highlighting or revealing, while the authored frame expresses assigned emphasis.

register: Formal academic and analytical noun for a conclusion drawn from evidence; the phrasal alternative is less technical.
trap: An inférence is a reasoning step or its conclusion, not a causal conséquence; unlike a déduction, it need not be logically necessary.
example_tl: Cette inférence repose sur un échantillon trop restreint pour établir que la baisse observée résulte effectivement du nouveau règlement.
example_en: This inference rests on a sample too limited to establish that the observed decline actually results from the new regulation.
cloze: Cette {{c1::inférence}} repose sur un échantillon trop restreint pour établir que la baisse observée résulte effectivement du nouveau règlement.
note: Old_back is accurate; the authored context fixes the broader, defeasible reasoning sense rather than strict deduction. Self-review removed a phrasal alternative that did not substitute cleanly in the example.

register: Neutral professional noun, commonly with apporter, for understanding yielded by evidence, investigation or analysis.
trap: Intuition often denotes an untested hunch or immediate apprehension; it does not reliably render an evidence-based analytical insight.
example_tl: L’enquête apporte un éclairage précieux sur les arbitrages internes qui ont conduit la plateforme à affaiblir discrètement ses propres règles.
example_en: The investigation provides valuable insight into the internal trade-offs that led the platform to quietly weaken its own rules.
cloze: L’enquête apporte un {{c1::éclairage}} précieux sur les arbitrages internes qui ont conduit la plateforme à affaiblir discrètement ses propres règles.
note: The context-free source has several readings. This note selects evidence-based understanding and materially diverges from old_back intuition.

register: Neutral analytical phrase for the particular lens or dimension through which a subject is examined.
trap: French perspective can also mean a future prospect, while point de vue often denotes a person’s opinion; angle d’analyse fixes the analytical-lens sense.
example_tl: Ce rapport adopte un angle d’analyse rarement considéré : les effets de la concentration numérique sur l’autonomie financière des médias locaux.
example_en: This report adopts a rarely considered perspective: the effects of digital concentration on the financial autonomy of local media.
cloze: Ce rapport adopte un {{c1::angle d’analyse}} rarement considéré : les effets de la concentration numérique sur l’autonomie financière des médias locaux.
note: The source is underspecified. Self-review selected the analytical-lens sense and retained old_back only as a valid alternative.

register: Formal reasoning term for a proposition from which an argument or conclusion proceeds.
trap: French prémisse has a double s and denotes a reasoning premise; prémices, always plural, means the beginnings or early signs of something.
example_tl: La prémisse centrale du projet est que davantage de données produisent nécessairement de meilleures décisions, hypothèse que plusieurs audits récents contredisent.
example_en: The project’s central premise is that more data necessarily produces better decisions, a hypothesis contradicted by several recent audits.
cloze: La {{c1::prémisse}} centrale du projet est que davantage de données produisent nécessairement de meilleures décisions, hypothèse que plusieurs audits récents contredisent.
note: Old_back is accurate; the trap records a productive spelling and lexical distinction.

register: Formal legal and analytical noun for a conclusion provisionally drawn from known facts until contrary evidence emerges.
trap: Ordinary English presumption can mean assumption, often hypothèse or supposition; French présomption is especially natural for legal or evidence-based inference.
example_tl: En l’absence de traces comptables, la présomption de coordination repose surtout sur la simultanéité des publications et la répétition des mêmes formulations.
example_en: In the absence of accounting records, the presumption of coordination rests mainly on the simultaneity of the publications and the repetition of identical wording.
cloze: En l’absence de traces comptables, la {{c1::présomption}} de coordination repose surtout sur la simultanéité des publications et la répétition des mêmes formulations.
note: The bare source is ambiguous. This note retains old_back for the evidential and quasi-legal sense demonstrated by the example.

register: Neutral-formal phrase for a reasoned answer that counters an argument point by point without necessarily disproving it conclusively.
trap: Réfutation can overstate the result: a rebuttal answers and counters an argument, whereas a réfutation claims to demonstrate that it is false.
example_tl: Sa réponse argumentée conteste méthodiquement les chiffres du lobby, mais reconnaît que certaines obligations pèseront davantage sur les petites entreprises.
example_en: Her rebuttal methodically challenges the lobby’s figures but acknowledges that some obligations will weigh more heavily on small businesses.
cloze: Sa {{c1::réponse argumentée}} conteste méthodiquement les chiffres du lobby, mais reconnaît que certaines obligations pèseront davantage sur les petites entreprises.
note: Materially diverges from old_back so that rebuttal remains distinct from the separate refutation card in this batch.

register: Formal academic and argumentative noun for a reasoned demonstration intended to show that a claim or conclusion is false.
trap: A réfutation requires counter-reasoning or evidence; a simple denial or institutional démenti does not by itself refute a claim.
example_tl: La réfutation publiée par les chercheurs identifie trois erreurs de calcul qui invalident directement la conclusion avancée par le cabinet de conseil.
example_en: The researchers’ published refutation identifies three calculation errors that directly invalidate the conclusion advanced by the consulting firm.
cloze: La {{c1::réfutation}} publiée par les chercheurs identifie trois erreurs de calcul qui invalident directement la conclusion avancée par le cabinet de conseil.
note: Old_back is accurate. Self-review made the example demonstrate actual disproof, preserving the distinction from rebuttal.

register: Neutral argumentative noun for a reason or line of reasoning offered in support of a conclusion.
trap: English argument can denote a quarrel, but French un argument is a supporting reason; a personal argument is une dispute or une querelle.
example_tl: L’argument selon lequel toute exigence de transparence révélerait des secrets industriels confond volontairement audit indépendant et divulgation publique du code source.
example_en: The argument that any transparency requirement would reveal trade secrets deliberately conflates independent auditing with public disclosure of source code.
cloze: L’{{c1::argument}} selon lequel toute exigence de transparence révélerait des secrets industriels confond volontairement audit indépendant et divulgation publique du code source.
note: Old_back is accurate for the reasoning sense; the trap records the productive English–French false-friend boundary. Self-review made the transparency example more idiomatic and removed a non-substitutable alternative.
